what: The per-body task returns the engine's Done (a findings COUNT), the verdict's Debug bytes and its reads; the verdict itself (diagnostics, findings, borrow findings) is dropped inside check_body. A driver cannot print a body's findings as `check` prints them, so engine-check prints one note per body with findings naming the count. Also `BodyFrame.frame` must live as long as the records ('n, invariant), so a body's frame cannot be reset per body: a run's frame holds every body's lowering until the run ends (runs are cut to 32 bodies for that).
cost: the findings-equal check of lane ES's test could not be written; the frame reset per body could not be done
cause: the body task was built for the equality tests (bytes and reads), before a printer read it
class: an interface sized for its tests, not for its first caller
prevention: asked of lane VB: BodyOut carries the verdict's printable findings (rule, range, words) in the shared allocator, and BodyFrame's frame takes its own lifetime apart from the records'
annoyance: source::Records is not Sync (RefCell, OnceCell), so 'one Records shared by all workers' means one per run over the shared bytes
workaround: one note per body with its count; one Records and one frame per run of at most 32 bodies
